**Transform Construction:** Apply 3D-DWT with RDLS and Step Skipping to the input volume.
**Entropy Estimation:** For each final subband, calculate the memoryless entropy $H$ for each candidate predictor.
**Predictor Selection:** Select the candidate predictor that results in the smallest memoryless entropy $H$ for each subband.
**Prediction and Residual:** For each sample in the subband, in raster scan order, compute the predicted value $V_{pred}$ using the selected predictor.
The heuristic selection of filters and predictors adds overhead.
The 3-level decomposition increases memory usage compared to 1 or 2 levels.
Adaptive to image content via heuristic selection.
RDLS filters are time-consuming to apply and select, offering little benefit over SS-DWT alone.
